strings.name: Dani Rodrik
strings.summary: Rodrik studies globalization, industrial policy and institutional diversity, emphasizing context rather than a single development recipe. He taught at Harvard, Columbia and the Institute for Advanced Study, examining tensions among democracy, national governance and integration. His books address globalization, economic methods, jobs and climate; Shared Prosperity in a Fractured World appeared in 2025.

strings.influence.rationale: Studied globalization, industrial policy and institutional differences, exploring development paths in open economies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: AB, Harvard(1979); MPA, Princeton(1981); economics PhD(1985).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Globalization trilemma
strings.highlights.h1.text: Analyzed tensions among democracy, national autonomy and deep economic integration.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Development and industrial policy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Studied structural change, institutional diversity and government policy, emphasizing local development conditions.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Shared-prosperity book
strings.timeline.t1.text: Published Shared Prosperity in a Fractured World on jobs, poverty and climate policy.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Returned to Harvard
strings.timeline.t2.text: Left the Institute for Advanced Study and returned to Harvard Kennedy School.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Institute for Advanced Study
strings.timeline.t3.text: Joined its School of Social Science, serving until 2015.
strings.timeline.t4.title: The Globalization Paradox
strings.timeline.t4.text: Published on democracy, nation-states and the global economy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: One Economics, Many Recipes
strings.timeline.t5.text: Argued that growth strategies must reflect institutional and development circumstances.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Has Globalization Gone Too Far?
strings.timeline.t6.text: Examined integration’s effects on social contracts and domestic policy space.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Early Harvard faculty
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined Harvard’s public-policy faculty after his Princeton economics PhD.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Harvard undergraduate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed Harvard’s bachelor’s before graduate training at Princeton.
